source.title: Dispatch cron review
source.author: Pranav Menon
source.text: Pranav: I have scheduled the production dispatch image refresh for every Friday at 15:00 Singapore time. It runs unattended, including configuration changes. I used the slot from the Release process wiki. This is routine housekeeping, not incident mitigation.

source.title: Approved October ETA timeout revision
source.author: Mei Tan
source.text: Mei: After the October latency review, replace the 600 millisecond route-model timeout with 500 milliseconds. Keep the timestamped carrier ETA fallback. I approve this change for the next Tuesday release; the freshness wording stays the same.

source.title: Thermal label procurement review
source.author: Kavya Iyer
source.text: Kavya: We will use matte thermal labels for all new depot scanner kits. Glossy stock caused reflections in the cold-room test. Nur approved the additional supply cost today. I own the procurement checklist and will update it before the next kit ships.
